attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (AlmaLinux 9). Installed aide via dnf, initialized the database against the distro-default config (which explicitly covers ~100 critical /etc paths plus a catch-all /etc PERMS rule), activated it as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, and validated detection by modifying and reverting /etc/issue (AIDE correctly reported the change with exit code 4 and exact hash/size diffs, then reported clean after revert). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and a clean AIDE check, issued `systemctl reboot` with the ack returning before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the AIDE database and integrity check both survived and remain functional post-restart.
